report:
Fresh final marker followup of meta.reviews.preparation. Preserved prior input/output, started fresh, assessed the complete claim, both ordinary implementation entries and all seven ordinary test bodies, and recaptured every prior dependency: review Fixture lines 1–106, shared check/workspace test, specification and correspondence inventories. Compared all fragments by path/selector and both metadata collections. The only change is an implementation_references association comment in supplementary spec.rs. All preparation behavior, claim, assertions, helpers and metadata are unchanged; no captures were removed. This isolated marker was assessed against the complete prior findings below.

review.rs start validates anchor syntax and current inventory and finds the requested anchor before changing records. It locks the validation parent, removes that anchor's old directory before publishing new input, creates the directory, writes captured input and unfinished summary, then returns that exact input. Other directories are untouched. Atomic per-file writes cannot restore an old output after removal; intermediate failure leaves missing/incomplete/unrecorded state, not approval of new inputs. main.rs reads optional instructions and prints returned serialized input after successful start. Inventory includes complete claim, implementation context, associated test functions and metadata. Shared check and workspace validation reject missing/unfinished review records. These mechanisms establish validation-before-clearing, persisted capture-before-printing, fresh-record requirement and isolation.

All seven tests supply concrete assertions. cli_start_and_record_roundtrip_exact_saved_input checks actual CLI stdout equals saved input and exact multiline instructions, then records and checks. initial_context_preserves_instructions_and_exact_uniform_fragments verifies prompt/instructions, saved equality and exact claim/file/test fragments. input_keeps_complete_association_metadata_and_appends_context_in_one_collection verifies metadata and unchanged initial prefix after reads. start_invalidates_previous_success_and_record_is_required proves restarting an unchanged approved fixture removes output and yields unfinished/failing state, reads cannot approve it, and fresh recording restores validity without changing input bytes. interrupted_start_publication_states_cannot_reuse_an_old_approval checks removed-directory, empty-directory and input-only states through both library and CLI gates, then requires recording after restart. This is intermediate-state testing, not filesystem fault injection. invalid_ids_and_paths_are_rejected_without_destroying_existing_reports checks malformed/unknown IDs preserve existing output and invalid reads preserve input. restarting_one_anchor_leaves_other_anchor_record_unchanged creates two approvals, restarts one and compares the other's summary/input/output bytes while restoring overall validity. Captured helpers build real Cargo/Design inputs and run actual CLI where asserted.

All preparation requirements are accounted for and no TODO/N/A entries exist. The supplementary comment changes none of these conclusions. No source edits, formatting, tests or workspace build were performed in this followup; executed review start/read, capture comparison and record only. No requested edits.
